# Derek's Guides - Documentation for AI Agents

## Overview
This is Derek's Guides (https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/), a collection of technical documentation for AI agents, homelab infrastructure, GitOps workflows, and self-hosting.

## Accessing Content
- **HTML Version**: https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/
- **Markdown Version**: Append `index.md` to any URL (e.g., https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/docs/openclaw/index.md)

## Documentation Sections

### OpenClaw
Documentation for the OpenClaw agent platform

- **Getting Started with OpenClaw**: https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/docs/openclaw/getting-started-openclaw/ - A quick introduction to OpenClaw agent orchestration
- **Lossless Claw**: https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/docs/openclaw/lossless-claw/ - Never Lose Context Again with persistent memory
- **OpenClaw + Hermes Integration**: https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/docs/openclaw/openclaw-hermes-integration/ - Connect OpenClaw to Hermes Agent

### Infrastructure
Homelab infrastructure and deployment guides

- **1Password Secrets Management**: https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/docs/security/1password-secrets-management/ - Secure secret management for GitOps
- **Ollama AMD ROCm**: https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/docs/infrastructure/ollama-amd-rocm-ms-s1-max/ - Run Ollama on AMD GPUs

### Security
Security frameworks and practices

- **SEL × Cynefin Autonomy Gates**: https://guides.derekleeds.cloud/docs/security/sel-cynefin-framework/ - Security Execution Levels and Cynefin framework for AI agent autonomy gates in homelab GitOps operations

## Agent-Specific Access Patterns

| Resource | HTML | Markdown |
|----------|------|----------|
| Homepage | / | N/A |
| Docs Section | /docs/ | /docs/index.md |
| Individual Page | /docs/SECTION/PAGE/ | /docs/SECTION/PAGE/index.md |
